tests.name: record=false creates no recorder or bag
Namespaced nodes and global command remap
Live reliable times out; best_effort receives
Same bag replay: reliable timeout and best_effort receipt
Monitor callback counts positive after fix

defect.reproducer: Start BEST_EFFORT relay with RELIABLE monitor and run reliable echo: no delivery, timeout=124.
defect.root_cause: Requested RELIABLE exceeds offered BEST_EFFORT reliability, although topic discovery succeeds.
defect.proof_after: BEST_EFFORT monitor/echo receive live messages. One recorded MCAP is replayed with explicit BEST_EFFORT override: reliable fails and best_effort receives the same input stream.
